ai.guide.validator.title: Running a 6529 validator too?
ai.guide.validator.body: Use a separate computer if you can. On one computer, an attacker who exploits a flaw in a model's engine can reach the validator's keys, and a busy model can slow its votes. If you run both, say so when the installer asks: 6529 AI then runs below normal priority.
